name: integration-radar
description: Watches partner API changelogs, deprecations and sunset schedules, maps each change to the connectors your product uses, and turns relevant changes into planned work.
author: Kevin Goff
highlights: Daily sweep of partner changelogs, deprecation notices and sunset schedules
Maps each change to the connectors and fields your product actually uses
Urgent alerts for anything due within 30 days, and an opt-in weekly digest
Works with the tracker, wiki and chat tools you already have in Crew
useCases: Catch a partner API version sunset weeks before your connector starts failing
See which of your connectors a deprecated field or endpoint actually touches
Keep one calendar of every partner deadline that matters to your product
Give an integrations team a shared, triaged feed instead of a pile of changelogs
configuration: Write a connector manifest (YAML) listing your partners, their public changelog and sunset pages, and the versions, endpoints and fields each connector uses; start from examples/integration-radar.manifest.yaml
Load it in the Setup tab; every sweep re-reads the file
Optional: confirm a tracker, wiki, chat or repo tool already configured in Crew; with none, the dashboard is the fallback
Optional: switch on the weekly digest and pick its day and time
